notes.text: The heading supplies the three-generation Mar Zutra–Rav Huna–Rav Pappi chain. The body says to Ravina, without naming the subject; He reflects that implicit entry context. The source locator חולין מח. is read conventionally as Chullin 48a, without a named-edition check.
